info.title: Paysafe Digital Wallets API
info.description: Accept payments from Skrill and NETELLER digital wallets, and pay out to them. Includes Crypto On-Ramp for fiat-to-crypto purchases.

tags.name: Crypto On-Ramp
tags.description: Let customers buy cryptocurrency with fiat held in a Skrill wallet.

post.description: Creates a new walletpayment. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payments, most recent first.
Retrieves a single walletpayment by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing walletpayment.

post.description: Cancels a wallet payment before capture.
Creates a new payout. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payouts, most recent first.
Retrieves a single payout by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing payout.

post.description: Cancels a payout that has not yet been executed.
Creates a new walletcustomer. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of customers, most recent first.
Retrieves a single walletcustomer by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing walletcustomer.

post.description: Returns an indicative rate and fee breakdown, valid for 60 seconds.

get.description: Retrieves a previously created quote and whether it is still valid.

post.description: Executes a fiat-to-crypto purchase against a live quote.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of on-ramp orders.
Returns the cryptocurrencies available to the customer, by jurisdiction.
